svg.title: A 3x3 convolution filter sliding across a 5x5 input
svg.desc: A 3 by 3 filter is overlaid on a 5 by 5 input grid at two consecutive positions, sliding one column to the right with stride 1. Each filter position produces one value in a 3 by 3 output grid, so a 5 by 5 input with a 3 by 3 filter yields a 3 by 3 output.
